name: Desert Hills Premium Outlets
description: Desert Hills Premium Outlets is one of Southern California's premier outlet shopping destinations, located just off Interstate 10 in Cabazon between Los Angeles and Palm Springs. Featuring over 180 brand-name and designer outlet stores including Gucci, Prada, Burberry, and Coach, this open-air center offers exceptional savings of 25% to 65% every day in a desert landscape setting with stunning mountain views.
demographics: Affluent tourists and shoppers traveling between Los Angeles and Palm Springs/Coachella Valley; families and international visitors seeking luxury brand outlets; median household income $75k+
summary: Southern California's largest designer outlet center featuring 180+ premium brand stores with daily savings between Los Angeles and Palm Springs.
